title: Over the Earth
caption: The whole courier at cruise: nozzle and reactor aft, four hot radiators, the hydrogen tank, and the two crew pods swinging on their tethers.

title: Pod on its tether
caption: Crew pod A seen from beyond its floor, with the two tether strands running 30 m back to the reels on the hub.

title: Under thrust
caption: Reactor at full power from the stern quarter: the radiators glow, the exhaust leaves through the magnetic nozzle, and both pods are wound home into their cradles.

title: Hub and crew module
caption: The turning drum with a pod cradle and its two reels, between the tank's foil-wrapped head and the crew module with its cargo hatch and docking port.
